BEGIN:VEVENT
DESCRIPTION:Join us for a welcoming space where math lovers come together to study independently\, side by side. Whether you are working through a textbook\, researching a new concept\, or progressing a personal project\, this is a time and space to allow you to prioritize your learning of the mathematics that's currently interesting you.\n\nWe gather twice a month on weekday evenings to work in parallel. We are each on our own path but let's help each other to continue our studies and learning.\n\nWhether you are a seasoned mathematician or simply mathematically minded\, you are welcome here. Bring your books or notes and your curiosity.\n\nWe look forward to learning alongside you!\n\n
